meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Use this when the user asks to search memory, "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or wants work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 回溯历史对话,找到之前怎么解决的
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望 AI 记得之前聊过的需求和方案
copy.tagline_en: Search past conversations to recall how you solved it
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with AI over many sessions and need it to remember earlier context.

howto.what: 当用户询问过去会话的解决过程或做法时,Claude 会在跨会话记忆库里检索相关记录,先给出含时间、标题的摘要列表,再按用户选定取回完整细节。
howto.when: 当用户提起之前做过的事或解决过的问题,比如“上次怎么修好的”“之前查过这类问题吗”等回忆型问题时触发。

say.text: 我们之前解决过验证码报错吗?查一下以前的会话记录。
say.note: 会触发记忆搜索并先显示摘要列表。

say.text: 找出上周关于权限设计的记录,列出内容。
say.note: 先出摘要,选定后再返回完整信息。

say.text: 查记忆里的bugfix记录,最近十条。
say.note: 可按类型过滤,只取修复类记录。

howto.what_en: When asked about past work or solutions from earlier sessions, Claude searches the cross-session memory store, returns a compact list of matching records with time and title, then fetches full details only for the entries you pick.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about previous sessions, e.g. "Did we fix this before?", "How did we solve X last time?", or want prior context.

say_en.text: Did we already solve the captcha issue before? Look up past sessions.
say_en.note: Triggers a memory search and lists results first.

say_en.text: Find our notes on permission design from last week.
say_en.note: Shows summaries, then details after you choose.

say_en.text: Search memory for bugfix records, latest ten.
say_en.note: Filters by type to get fix-related entries.
